scope: Randomized variants of the 2, 3, 4 and 5 target requests of the six production tank builds (validation/2026-10-07-tanking-several-targets-sweep/*.base.json): the Protection, Holy Protection and Ret Protection Paladin, the Feral (bear) Druid and the Protection and Fury Protection Warrior, every copy of the boss swinging at the tank. 16 for each base at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical, and draws each variant's race from Human, Dwarf and Undead for the Paladins, Night Elf and Tauren for the bear and Human, Dwarf, Orc and Undead for the Warriors.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-07-tanking-several-targets-sweep/NAME-N-targets.base.json --seed 20261007 --count 16 --iterations 200 --max-distance 5 --races RACES --output <scratch>/NAME-N for each base, with RACES as the scope says; each variant <scratch>/NAME-N/sweep-XX.json is compared as NAME-N-targets-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants named as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log: all 384, with every copy of the boss dealing damage to the tank in each.

The variants lower talents, drop buffs, debuffs, consumables and gear and change the distance, reaction time and random stream mode, so the blocks, parries, crits and crushes the copies land, the shields and procs they trigger and the debuffs on each copy vary from one to the next.
